Repair the offline EPIC collective collector in `/workspace/project`.
It must consume finite four-port packet captures and return exact wire and buffer certificates.
The supplied C codec and switch retain their real collective and transport behavior.
Extend that pipeline to satisfy `/workspace/PROTOCOL.md`; its current live-I/O assumptions are insufficient.
Support all six collectives, wrapped PSNs, cumulative ACKs, bounded retention and local backpressure.
Mode 2 translates reliability; mode 3 owns result retransmission after acknowledging input.
Their storage and acknowledgment dependencies must remain correct under reordered and duplicate traffic.
Malformed wire frames must never mutate collector state beyond their diagnostic classification.
No NIC, switch, GPU or external service is involved: all replay runs offline on CPU.
The contract defines every sequence mapping, boundary, emission priority and certificate byte.
Keep `project/solver.py` as the JSON stdin/stdout entry point; the whole source project is collected.
You may edit the C modules, Python adapter, headers and build files, or replace their internals.
GCC, make and libc headers are available; build only in scratch during collected replay.
See `/workspace/LIMITS.md` for artifact, execution, scratch and syscall restrictions.
Run `python3 public_check.py project/solver.py` as the ordinary development user.
The two public examples check basic plumbing and one collective only; the full contract applies.
Illegal batches return exactly {"error":"invalid"}, exit0, with no partial case results.


Work in /workspace. When finished run exactly: echo COMPLETE_TASK_AND_SUBMIT_FINAL_OUTPUT
items.finalText:
The implementation is complete and verified. Here's a summary of the work:

## What was repaired

**`project/src/star4_switch.c`** — rewritten as the offline four-port collective collector implementing `PROTOCOL.md`:

- **Wire validation before endpoint validation**: exact frame length vs. IPv4 length, `0x45` version/IHL, protocol 17, IPv4 header checksum, flags/frag exactly `0x0000`/`0x4000`, UDP length = IPv4−20, both ports 4791, zero UDP checksum, BTH opcode/`0xffff` pkey/zero QPN top byte/APSN top byte, DATA payload exactly `4D`, ACK body exactly the 4‑byte AETH (`0x1f` top byte, `psn+1`), and the reflected CRC32 ICRC. Invalid frames only advance their diagnostic counter.
- **Bounded retention** keyed by the *logical* sequence: accepted/duplicate/blocked/stale classification using `b` at packet arrival, first-occurrence wins (even for a differing payload), no slot overwrites.
- **ACK ownership**: per-source received prefixes `R`, per-destination sent `S` and acknowledged `A` prefixes, upstream sent prefixes `U`, and repeat requests that persist until an ACK succeeds. Mode 3 makes contributions safe immediately; mode 2 applies the per-collective safety rules (including the gather ordinal mapping `3p+ord(d,s)` and the reducescatter block mapping).
- **Emission priority**: pending upstream ACKs in ascending rank → (retry only) the selected receiver's unacknowledged results in ascending `q` → new results in ascending destination rank and `q`; a failed attempt emits nothing, advances nothing and ends the opportunity (local backpressure).
- **Retirement** of fully complete, fully acknowledged and upstream-covered inputs, plus the exact FNV1a64 buffer digest.

**`project/src/replay_api.c`** / **`include/collector.h`** — the offline transport ABI over the collector; **`project/src/roce_packet.c`** keeps the real codec (only the ICRC scratch buffer was enlarged); **`project/wire.py`** keeps the exact wire format with a cached header/ICRC prefix (verified byte-identical); **`project/solver.py`** validates the whole batch first (illegal ⇒ exactly `{"error":"invalid"}`, exit 0, no compilation), builds the C project into scratch, replays and serializes the certificates.

## Verification
- `python3 public_check.py project/solver.py` → **2/2 public examples pass** (byte-identical wire transcript, digests and state).
- 40+ illegal-request shapes return `{"error":"invalid"}` with exit 0; legal edge cases are accepted.
- Targeted tests for all six collectives, both modes, wrapped PSNs, slot reuse after retirement, duplicates/stale/blocked, budget exhaustion, retries and snapshots; counter invariants (`18 = 22+23+24+25`, `18+19+26+27 = ingress`, zero overwrites) hold over randomized traces; a C fuzz harness under `MALLOC_CHECK_=3` shows no memory errors.
- Worst-case batches (2^20 work units, 3.1 M egress frames) finish in ~10 s, well inside the 120 s budget.
